snippet.title: Spellbound Emporium - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3673300/Spellbound_Emporium/

Welcome to Spellbound Emporium where YOU manage a cozy store in a fantasy kingdom.

Pick which books to sell and serve a variety of magical customers each with their favourite books, gifts and potions. 

Learn to harness the powers of your books as their magical effects can upgrade your store and boost your customer’s happiness.

You’ll need to stock up your store buy buying furniture,  gifts and potions and carefully manage the finances, customer satisfaction and reputation of your store by keeping a good variety of books and items.

Grow your own ingredients for crafting your own potions and brewing spells to boost your store’s appeal, or grow plants to sell and decorate your store to make it feel like home.

If you succeed in your daily goals, unlock new items, customisation options and expand your store to make room for more stock and even more customers!
